product_summary: Catalogue read from ceratapharma.com sitemap/products.xml (90+ product URLs, dated 2026-10-30..2026-11-24). Real product lines: (1) steroid/hormone APIs — testosterone esters, nandrolone esters, trenbolone, drostanolone, stanozolol, oxandrolone, DHEA, progesterone, dydrogesterone, norethisterone; (2) corticosteroids — clobetasol propionate, halobetasol propionate, hydrocortisone acetate, prednisolone, triamcinolone acetonide, beclomethasone, mometasone furoate, fluocinolone acetonide; (3) oncology — oxaliplatin, paclitaxel, mitomycin C, gemcitabine, olaparib, ruxolitinib, nilotinib, lapatinib, imatinib mesylate, gefitinib, letrozole, fulvestrant; (4) peptide hormones — semaglutide, tirzepatide, retatrutide, liraglutide, leuprolide, triptorelin; (5) antibiotics/antifungals — erythromycin stearate, nystatin, mupirocin, fusidic acid, fluconazole, itraconazole, ofloxacin; (6) local anaesthetics — lidocaine, mepivacaine, ropivacaine, prilocaine, tetracaine, procaine; (7) statins, PDE5 inhibitors, NSAIDs, vitamins (biotin, riboflavin, methylcobalamin), tacrolimus, tretinoin, permethrin, resorcinol, theophylline, ambroxol, tapentadol.
role_hint: manufacturer (self-declared API manufacturer with GMP/WHO-GMP facilities in Gujarat; no independent verification of plant or of any shipment performed in this HS-only review)
comment: INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: declared industry 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is wrong — this is a pharmaceutical API manufacturer (steroid/hormone/oncology/peptide APIs). Should be reclassified to pharma/API. HS MATCH: partial. Declared 293339/293349/293359/293719 cover only the heterocyclic and polypeptide-hormone part of the portfolio (tadalafil, sildenafil, tamsulosin, etoricoxib, letrozole, and the GLP-1/peptide hormones semaglutide, tirzepatide, liraglutide, leuprolide, triptorelin). The company's CORE lines are entirely absent from the declaration: steroid hormones (293729 — testosterone/nandrolone/trenbolone/drostanolone/stanozolol/oxandrolone), progestogens (293723 — progesterone, dydrogesterone, norethisterone), corticosteroids (293721/293722 — clobetasol, halobetasol, hydrocortisone acetate, prednisolone, triamcinolone, beclomethasone, mometasone, fluocinolone), spironolactone (293750), macrolide/polyene antibiotics (294190 — erythromycin stearate, nystatin, mupirocin, fusidic acid), azoles (293399 — fluconazole, itraconazole), oncology cytotoxics (293979/284390 — paclitaxel, oxaliplatin, mitomycin C, gemcitabine), local anaesthetics and other amides (292429 — lidocaine, bupivacaine-class, ambroxol, tapentadol), and vitamins (293623/293626/293629). Per project rule 3 an HS mismatch is NOT a rejection ground: company is retained, verdict accepted_hs_corrected — the declared code set must be replaced by the actual steroid/corticosteroid/antibiotic/oncology headings above. TRADER SIGNS: none found — no 'trader/distributor/agent' wording on the site; the site presents itself as an API manufacturer with own R&D and 5 facilities in Gujarat. However, the breadth of the catalogue (90+ APIs across steroids, oncology cytotoxics, GLP-1 peptides, anaesthetics, statins, vitamins) is unusually wide for a single API plant and is typical of a multi-sourcing/marketing operation — worth flagging as a possible manufacturer_trader, but this is an inference, not evidence. FACTUALITY: product pages are JS-rendered and disclose no HS codes, no CAS numbers, no shipment or customs references; no customs line, B/L or GST record was checked in this HS-only review. Therefore every product line above is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — declared on the company website, not corroborated by any customs record. Revenue, export volume, PAN and CIN were not researched per scope: null.
